_provenance.note: FY2022 defense budget package — historical CR / lapse record (Release R4, plan §4.4). DELIBERATELY EMPTY of asserted dates, public-law numbers, and dollar figures. Each interim-funding period becomes a date and a P.L. number Capiro shows a customer as an official fact, so each one must be hand-transcribed from the enacted text or an official CRS/appropriations-status source WITH a URL, and reviewed, before --commit. Nothing here may be reconstructed from memory.
howToCurate: 1. For each continuing resolution in FY2022, add an interimFundingPeriods[] entry: sequence (1-based, contiguous, no gaps), vehicleLabel, startDate, coverageThrough (the date it funded operations THROUGH), billId, publicLaw, and sourceUrl.
2. shutdownDays = days of LAPSED appropriations that began at the END of that period. Use 0 when funding was continuous — omitting it is not the same as zero.

3. Add the full-year vehicle (omnibus / minibus / full-year CR / consolidated act) to vehicles[] with track=appropriation (or interim_funding for a full-year CR), stage=enacted, its publicLaw, and status=enacted.
4. Add the enacted defense topline to positions[] with the EXACT FUNDING_SCOPES basis the enacted text measures, units:"millions", a sourceUrl, and a sourcePage.
6. Then dry-run against the database, read every WARNING/CONFLICT line, and only then re-run with --commit.
